verdict.rationale: PayPal Agentic Commerce handles merchant and buyer data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions training-data use, opt-out controls, or data-retention policy for AI models. The pack covers only checkout protocols, cart APIs, the agent toolkit, the MCP server, webhooks, fees and the sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
